rows.monthly_emoluments: Rs 31,000 + HRA or Rs 25,000 + HRA (see Pay and Tenure)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Masters/ Integrated Masters in Natural or Agricultural or Pharmaceutical Sciences/ MVSc/ Animal Sciences or equivalent OR Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent Desirable qualification: Experience in handling microbes, molecular identification, phenotypic characterization and preservation. Experience in molecular biology techniques i.e. DNA isolation, RNA isolation, PCR, RT-PCR, Sanger sequencing, microbial genomics, etc. The notice gives an upper age limit of 35 years. It does not print a date for counting age. Result awaited candidates are not eligible to apply. In case of any dispute, the English version of the notice will prevail. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Sc./ 3 years Diploma in Engineering/ Technology.
rows.desirable: Working knowledge in handling microbial strains, including their cultivation, preservation, and identification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a fixed monthly emolument plus HRA. The notice does not state the tenure of the project posts. Project Assistant-II (PA-II): Rs20,000 + HRA per month. Project Associate-I (PAT-I), rate 1: Rs.31,000/- + HRA for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including lectureship/ assistant professorship or GATE, OR who have qualified national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. Project Associate-I (PAT-I), rate 2: Rs.25,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under rate 1.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IMTECH Recruitment 2026 under Rolling Advt. No. 2026-11-04?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project Assistant-II (PA-II) and 1 Project Associate-I (PAT-I).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the CSIR-IMTECH Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Sc./ 3 years Diploma in Engineering/ Technology. Working knowledge in handling microbial strains, including their cultivation, preservation, and identification, is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Masters/ Integrated Masters in Natural or Agricultural or Pharmaceutical Sciences/ MVSc/ Animal Sciences or equivalent, OR a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-IMTECH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ ST/ PwBD/ Women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CSIR-IMTECH Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Rs 31,000 + HRA a month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET (including lectureship/ assistant professorship), GATE or an equivalent national level examination of DBT/DST and similar bodies; Rs 25,000 + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the CSIR-IMTECH Project Assistant-II?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant-II post carries monthly emoluments of Rs20,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay for CSIR-IMTECH project posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice lists HRA in addition to the monthly emoluments for both Project Assistant-II and Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q8. Can result awaited candidates apply for CSIR-IMTECH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that result awaited candidates are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. Which project are the CSIR-IMTECH posts for?
faq.answer: Both posts are under the project "Microbial Type Culture Collection and Gene Bank (MTCC), a Microbial Resource and International Depository Authority (IDA)", Project Code GAP-0233, at CSIR-IMTECH, Chandigarh.
